description:
## 1.0.0 (2026-11-13)

### ✨ New Features

* initial SoundCloud combined patches for Morphe ([badb835](https://github.com/longthree1/morphe-patches/commit/badb8354db43bd7a5b5e5bcd0c78444547789366))

patches.name: AMOLED dark theme
patches.description: Changes dark theme surfaces, the bottom navigation bar, and the mini-player footer to true black (#000000) for AMOLED screens while preserving SoundCloud orange accents.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops SoundCloud's TrackingHandler from storing and dispatching analytics events. Other tracking SDKs and online services remain active.

patches.name: Disable consent popup
patches.description: Uses SoundCloud's no-op consent controller to skip the OneTrust popup. Does not grant consent or disable tracking; select Disable analytics separately.

patches.name: Enable SoundCloud Go+ (experimental)
patches.description: Enables client-side Go+ UI flags and standard-quality (SQ) offline track/playlist caching. High-quality audio streaming (HQ / 256kbps AAC) and high-quality downloads do NOT work because stream quality entitlements are enforced server-side.

patches.name: Hide Cast icon
patches.description: Hides SoundCloud's Cast button in both the toolbar menu and standalone media route views.

patches.name: Home in Android Auto
patches.description: Fills the car Home tab with regular cover tiles from the phone's Home, using the app's existing account. Tracks, mixes and artists play; playlists and albums open. Publishes the real playback queue for Up next, with queue item selection. Falls back to SoundCloud's original car Home if the phone Home cannot load.

patches.name: Remove ads and upsells
patches.description: Stops SoundCloud from requesting audio/display ads and hides Go upsell prompts. Does not change the account's plan, features or entitlements.

patches.name: Vietnamese language
patches.description: Adds Vietnamese UI resources and known server-provided interface labels, preserves content titles, and enables Tiếng Việt in app locale selection.
